name: kurei_idle
desc: Pixel art game sprite, side view, full body from head to tail tip, standing still in a neutral idle pose facing left, all four feet planted flat on the ground, head held level in profile, looking straight ahead to the left in the walking direction. A big, heavy, burly four-legged dragon with a glossy wet clay-like body: shiny teal skin with strong highlights, cream-yellow throat, chest, belly, and underside of the tail. A fairly small head compared to the huge body. A smooth cream chest and a huge, round, heavy cream belly. Thick neck, long sturdy body, thick strong legs with big grey claws. Thick tail ending in a wide fin-shaped tip. Light, short blond hair: a few simple pointed tufts on top of the head and a thin mane running down the neck and back. Flat salmon-orange markings painted on the skin: triangle patterns on the back and shoulders, short stripes on the snout, cheeks and front legs. Two dark grey horns at the back of the head, a large curved tan-brown horn arching forward over the eye, cream furry ears. Large eyes with clearly visible white sclera, yellow iris, black slit pupil with a small white highlight, heavy half-lidded eyes with a mischievous, teasing, scheming look. The head is shaped like the face reference: a flat forehead and a long, flat snout that tapers gently to a smooth rounded tip, with a long, simple mouth line. The only details on the face are the eye, the mouth line and a small white fang at the corner of the closed mouth, which is curled up in a sly, mischievous smirk. Thick glossy drips of teal and cream goo running down the belly, legs and tail tip, with small puddles on the ground. Plain flat background, the dragon alone.
refs: draw the face in the same simple, clean anime style as this drawing - head shape with a flat top and long flat snout, large eyes with clear white sclera, heavy half-lidded mischievous look, light spiky hair; the snout is plain and clean; the head should be drawn a bit smaller relative to the body than here
design reference only for the body: four-legged body, fin-tipped tail, claws, dripping goo; do not copy its pose; the drawing is cute and simplified, so make the body bulkier
